assumptions: No GTFS, pedestrian graph, road topology, live vehicle state, or disruption feed is included in this milestone.
baseline: The bounded reference input contains 1,796,655 matching published service requests over 183 complete dates; it is workload evidence, not an outcome.

constraints.expression: no observed, causal, deployed, or impact claim from proposed effects

limitations: The negative release demonstrates a missing-network gate and does not evaluate actual mobility performance.
Do not treat city polygons or request-area labels as a routable transport network.
Do not call a proposed allocation a real-time routing result.
question: Can the committed city evidence support real-time multimodal rerouting and disruption allocation?
title: New York City: Real-time multimodal rerouting gate
